messages:
priya: quick check — I'm onboarding sage-mini-v3 weights for customer-zen (uploaded to gs://redwood-weights/customer-zen/sage-mini-v3/2026-03-18). noticed tokenization delta vs our chat template: special token for BOS is different in the model tokenizer (<|bos|> vs <s>). before I flip the serving config I want a sanity check on add_bos/add_eos and pad_side defaults. also model-configs/sage-mini-v3.json is staged with quantization: q4_0.safetensors. can someone eyeball?

sylvia: on it — ran a quick encode of the canonical system+user prompt and dumped tokens. looks like tokenizer.prepend_bos = true by default, and the chat template we use also inserts a sentinel. result: double-bos in some runs. snippet: ```python
>>> t.encode("<system>\nYou are helpful")
[1, 2, 345, ...]  # 1 is BOS token
```

harry: fwiw I saw the same locally. setting add_bos=false in the tokenizer loader fixes it for our template. quick patch suggestion: in model-configs set "tokenizer": {"add_bos": false, "add_eos": true}. that preserves termination but prevents duplicate bos.

jm: weights path looks fine. confirmed q4_0.safetensors present and checksum matches. one gotcha — runtime fastload path expects .safetensors, good you used that. if anyone accidentally pushes .pt our packaging script will convert but it adds a minute to deploy.

priya: @harry @sylvia thanks — do we need to change any prompts in the repo or just the serving config? I want minimal user-visible change.

sylvia: just config for now. but we should add a unit test to prompt-encoding-tests to assert no leading BOS when using our chat_template. I can add a small test case.

harry: agree on test. quick diff for loaders: ```diff
- tokenizer = Tokenizer(load_default=True)
+ tokenizer = Tokenizer(load_default=True, add_bos=False)
```

ops-bot: deploy-check: Dedicated pool capacity available in us-west-2 (80% free). no rollout blockers flagged.

priya: perfect. I'll update model-configs/sage-mini-v3.json, add the unit test in tests/encoding/test_chat_template.py, and open PR #4823. can @harry or @sylvia review when ready? :thumbsup:

sylvia: happy to review, ping me in PR.

harry: will review early tomorrow.

priya: thanks team — landing plan: update config + tests, run CI, then canary on staging with 5% traffic, watch token counts & latency. if anyone spots odd token counts post-deploy drop a note here and I'll rollback.

jm: noted — I'll watch the serving logs for any tokenization mismatch alerts.

priya: closing loop for now, will post PR link once ready.
